key_insight: SDGNN combines staggered discontinuous Galerkin structure with neural networks to bound solution error by discretization error, a computable loss-based training term, and network projection error.
engineering_relevance: The method offers an error-aware neural solver for scalar elliptic engineering models, including problems with prescribed interface jumps.
method: Patchwise networks satisfy SDG continuity conditions for every parameter choice.
Training minimizes the squared dual norm of the weak residual without differentiating the networks.
The formulation uses no boundary penalty or convection stabilization weights.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments show that square-root loss tracks error during training, prescribed square and circular interface jumps are captured consistently across initializations, and SDGNN outperforms PINNs at matched parameter counts.
watch_item: The loss controls the training-error component, not the full solution error; discretization and network projection errors must also be assessed.
paper_title: A Staggered Discontinuous Galerkin Neural Network Method with a Computable Error Decomposition
